caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, lidded urn with two ornate handles. The urn is predominantly gold and bronze in color, embellished with blue and red highlights on the base and lid. The central body of the urn features sculpted figures of cherubs or putti in relief, surrounded by intricate floral and foliate patterns. The lid is domed and decorated with a band of repeating bead motifs, topped with a cylindrical finial that has a golden appearance and a small circular knob attached to its side. The handles are embellished with scrolls and floral details, extending from the shoulders of the urn and curving outward, then downward. The base is round and elaborately decorated with repeating patterns in blue, brown, and gold. The urn is positioned centrally on a plain, beige background.
title: Ornamental Oil Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
